mapper.select: select plant_cd, plant_nm, use_yn from sys_plant where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, plant_cd
select use_yn from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd}
select item_id, item_cd, unit_cd, use_yn from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}

select coalesce((select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = #{unitCd}), (select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = #{unitCd}))
select item_id, item_cd, item_nm, unit_cd, use_yn from mst_item where use_yn = 'Y' and (item_cd ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or item_nm ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\') order by item_cd limit 50
select c.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, s.trade_status from mst_cust c join srm_supplier s on s.cust_id = c.cust_id where s.trade_status <> 'BLOCKED' and c.use_yn = 'Y' order by c.cust_cd limit 2000
mapper.sql: p.pr_id, p.pr_no, p.pr_date, p.plant_cd, pl.plant_nm, p.req_user_id, ru.login_id as req_login_id, ru.user_nm as req_user_nm, p.dept_nm, p.need_date, p.reason, p.status, p.decided_by, du.user_nm as decided_by_nm, p.decided_at, p.reject_reason, p.cancel_reason, (select count(*) from srm_pr_line l where l.pr_id = p.pr_id) as line_cnt, p.row_ver, p.updated_at, p.updated_by
from srm_pr p left join sys_plant pl on pl.plant_cd = p.plant_cd left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id = p.req_user_id left join sys_user du on du.user_id = p.decided_by
mapper.select:
select
order by p.pr_date desc, p.pr_id desc limit 2000

select
order by
p.pr_no pl.plant_nm is null, pl.plant_nm ru.user_nm is null, ru.user_nm p.need_date is null, p.need_date (select count(*) from srm_pr_line l where l.pr_id = p.pr_id) p.status p.pr_date
desc,
p.pr_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select p.pr_id, p.pr_no, p.status, p.req_user_id, p.row_ver from srm_pr p where p.pr_id = #{id} for update

select l.pr_line_id, l.pr_id, l.line_no, l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.use_yn as item_use_yn, trim_scale(l.qty)::text as qty, l.unit_cd, l.need_date, l.pref_cust_id, c.cust_cd as pref_cust_cd, c.cust_nm as pref_cust_nm, l.remark, l.line_status from srm_pr_line l join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = l.pref_cust_id where l.pr_id = #{prId} order by l.line_no

insert into srm_pr (comp_cd, pr_no, pr_date, plant_cd, req_user_id, dept_nm, need_date, reason, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{prNo}, #{prDate}, #{f.plantCd}, #{reqUserId}, #{f.deptNm}, #{f.needDate}, #{f.reason}, #{by}, #{by}) returning pr_id
mapper.update: update srm_pr set plant_cd = #{f.plantCd}, dept_nm = #{f.deptNm}, need_date = #{f.needDate}, reason = #{f.reason}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where pr_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer} and status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(line_no), 0) + 1 from srm_pr_line where pr_id = #{prId}
mapper.insert: insert into srm_pr_line (comp_cd, pr_id, line_no, item_id, qty, unit_cd, need_date, pref_cust_id, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{prId}, #{lineNo}, #{f.itemId}, #{f.qty}, #{f.unitCd}, #{f.needDate}, #{f.prefCustId}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.update: update srm_pr_line set item_id = #{f.itemId}, qty = #{f.qty}, unit_cd = #{f.unitCd}, need_date = #{f.needDate}, pref_cust_id = #{f.prefCustId}, remark = #{f.remark}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where pr_line_id = #{f.prLineId} and ((item_id, qty, unit_cd) is distinct from (#{f.itemId}::bigint, #{f.qty}::numeric, #{f.unitCd}::varchar) or need_date is distinct from #{f.needDate}::date or pref_cust_id is distinct from #{f.prefCustId}::bigint or remark is distinct from #{f.remark}::varchar)
mapper.select: select count(*) from srm_po_line l join srm_pr_line r on r.pr_line_id = l.pr_line_id join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id where r.pr_id = #{prId} and p.status <> 'CANCELLED' and l.line_status <> 'CANCELLED'
mapper.update: update srm_pr set status = #{to}, decided_by = case when #{to} in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') then #{decidedBy}::bigint else decided_by end, decided_at = case when #{to} in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') then now() else decided_at end, reject_reason = case when #{to} = 'REJECTED' then #{rejectReason} else reject_reason end, cancel_reason = case when #{to} = 'CANCELLED' then #{cancelReason} else cancel_reason end, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where pr_id = #{id} and status = #{from} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
